theme.name: Obsidian Executive
rules: Zero new dependencies — theme engine is stdlib ANSI in internal/tui/theme.go
NO_COLOR and --no-color respected; dumb terminals fall back to ASCII
--json output is byte-stable and never carries styling
Styling lives only in render layer, never in pipeline/policy
Every color has a text label — never color-alone semantics
Exit codes unchanged: 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 bad config, 3 degraded
